modules.name: Android SIM Host Application
modules.responsibility: Hosts foreground service, default-dialer integration, repositories, UI shell, and coordinates transport/audio components.
modules.regression_impact: Breaks overall SIM host startup, service binding, or manifest permissions across all subsystems.
modules.ownership_boundary: Owns Android app packaging/manifest wiring; delegates cryptographic protocol rules to shared-core and privileged HAL operations to helper-ipc.

modules.name: Android Companion Client Application
modules.responsibility: Acts as a second-Android BLE central companion performing calls, Telecom self-managed connection, audio playout/uplink, and SMS display.
modules.regression_impact: Breaks second-Android companion behavior without directly risking SIM host stability.
modules.ownership_boundary: Independent companion APK; shares wire contract strictly via android/core and must never depend on android/app or android/helper.

modules.name: Shared Protocol Core (Kotlin/JVM & Android Opus)
modules.responsibility: Defines wire framing, ECDH/AES-GCM handshake & records, message schemas, G.711/Concentus Opus codecs, and Android MediaCodec Opus wrapper.
modules.regression_impact: Cross-platform protocol/crypto incompatibility affecting both Android and iOS.
modules.ownership_boundary: android/core must remain pure JVM (zero Android SDK, app, or helper imports) and stay in strict parity with ios/TetherCore via protocol/compatibility.json.

modules.name: Android Telecom, Screening & Self-Managed Calls
modules.responsibility: Handles default-dialer InCallService callbacks, SIM call state propagation, call blocking, and synthetic loopback TestConnectionService.
modules.regression_impact: Stuck call states, ghost calls, or loss of default-dialer call control.
modules.ownership_boundary: Owns Android Telecom framework integration; must preserve local handset audio fallback when helper/link is absent and keep TestConnectionService isolated from real SIM calls.

modules.name: SMS Synchronization, Multipart Accounting & OTP
modules.responsibility: Polls Android SMS content provider, tracks multipart send completion, formats snippets, and detects OTP verification codes.
modules.regression_impact: Missed first SMS (_id = 1), duplicate/misreported multipart SMS sends, or OTP leakage in diagnostics.
modules.ownership_boundary: Handles PII-sensitive SMS/OTP content in memory and encrypted session only; never logs raw SMS/OTP bodies.

modules.name: Contacts, Number Formatting & Lookup
modules.responsibility: Synchronizes Android contacts/favorites and performs cross-platform phone number normalization and fuzzy search.
modules.regression_impact: Wrong caller ID resolution or leakage of address book metadata.
modules.ownership_boundary: Android SIM host owns contact database truth; clients maintain ephemeral/local snapshots only.

modules.name: Android Cellular Audio Strategy & HAL Engine
modules.responsibility: Selects capture/injection routes, enforces TYPE_TELEPHONY downlink validation, manages mic redirect/mute guards, and runs self-tests.
modules.regression_impact: One-way or muted SIM calls, ambient mic leakage instead of downlink, or vendor mixer lockouts requiring phone reboot.
modules.ownership_boundary: Requires explicit carrier SIM hardware evidence before changing route preference or claiming audible two-way success.

modules.name: Shell Helper Daemon, Lock & Loopback IPC
modules.responsibility: Runs privileged shell (uid 2000) HelperMain process bound to 127.0.0.1 with HMAC mutual auth, token file unlink, single-instance lock, and Net switches.
modules.regression_impact: Local privilege boundary exposure on uid 2000 (CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT, MODIFY_PHONE_STATE) or dangling helper tokens.
modules.ownership_boundary: Zero Android app UI dependencies; accepts loopback connections only after challenge-response HMAC verification and bounded deadlines.

modules.name: ADB Bootstrap Guard & Supervised USB Bridge
modules.responsibility: Enforces fail-closed Wireless ADB bootstrap policy, manages owner-supervised USB attach/reattach, and maintains 7-state Helper health telemetry.
modules.regression_impact: Exposes shell bootstrap secrets over unauthenticated TrustAll TLS if ADB_HELPER_BOOTSTRAP_ALLOWED is bypassed.
modules.ownership_boundary: Maintains ADB_HELPER_BOOTSTRAP_ALLOWED = false until genuine adbd server-identity trust pinning exists; USB tokens use stdin + mktemp only.

modules.name: Bluetooth LE L2CAP & GATT Transport
modules.responsibility: Provides primary low-energy peripheral/central transport with L2CAP CoC stream and GATT chunk fallback plus background wake characteristics.
modules.regression_impact: Loss of baseline pairing, wake reliability, or Bluetooth-only operation.
modules.ownership_boundary: Must remain independently operable without Wi-Fi or hotspot; intentionally avoids OS link-layer BT bonding downgrade traps.

modules.name: Local Wi-Fi LAN & Adaptive Hybrid Failover
modules.responsibility: Upgrades paired sessions to authenticated local TCP when available and handles rapid 12s silence detection and lossless fallback to BLE.
modules.regression_impact: CallKit 22s timeouts on silent Wi-Fi drops, traffic exposure if bound on untrusted public networks.
modules.ownership_boundary: Carries encrypted records only;ShareProxy remains contained/disabled unless dedicated security design lands.

modules.name: Logical Session State, Fencing & Command Ledger
modules.responsibility: Coordinates call ownership, monotonic transport epoch/audioFence leases, command idempotency ledger, and cross-device sync state.
modules.regression_impact: Stale call commands replayed after reconnect, mixed-version unleased audio leakage, or zombie foreground sessions.
modules.ownership_boundary: Single source of session ownership across transports; mediates audio vs control state transitions.

modules.name: Cryptographic Keys, Handshake, Backup & Diagnostics Redaction
modules.responsibility: Manages identity keypairs, P-256 ECDH + AES-256-GCM transport security, backup exclusion rules, and sanitized problem report builders.
modules.regression_impact: Session key compromise, nonce reuse, private key backup leakage, or secret leaks in exported problem reports.
modules.ownership_boundary: Any change requires cross-platform test vector validation (tether-vectors) and security review.

modules.name: iOS Core Package (TetherCore & COpus)
modules.responsibility: Provides UI-free Swift package covering BLE central, LAN link, crypto, Opus FFI bindings, playout jitter buffer, DialLink, and number/OTP utilities.
modules.regression_impact: Protocol drift from Android host or Swift-to-C Opus memory safety bugs.
modules.ownership_boundary: Must remain runnable on Linux/macOS via `swift test` without UIKit/SwiftUI/CallKit dependencies.

modules.name: iOS Audio Engine, CallKit & AirPods HFP Routing
modules.responsibility: Manages CallKit CXProvider lifecycle, AVAudioEngine voice processing, dynamic sample-rate conversion for AirPods HFP, and audio route cooldown/recovery.
modules.regression_impact: AVAudioEngine crash during HFP route shifts, stuck CallKit UI on outgoing cancel, or stalled playout audio.
modules.ownership_boundary: Requires macOS Xcode build + physical iPhone/AirPods verification; UI stays cleanly separated in Views/.

modules.name: Android & iOS User Interfaces & Localization
modules.responsibility: Implements Material 3 Compose / Android views and SwiftUI tabs with A4 Flat Premium dark-first design tokens and English/Persian localization.
modules.regression_impact: Hidden/misleading pipeline states, accidental screenshot leakage of USB tokens (missing FLAG_SECURE), or missing FA strings.
modules.ownership_boundary: Protected visual identity & semantic color resources enforced by tools/check-guardrails.py.

modules.name: Build Scripts, Guardrails & CI/CD Workflows
modules.responsibility: Provides protocol checkers, architecture boundary checks, privacy scanners, AltStore metadata generator, USB helper launcher scripts, and GitHub workflows.
modules.regression_impact: Broken supply-chain pins, bypassed privacy/protocol checks, or unapproved signing/billing execution.
modules.ownership_boundary: Protected paths in check-guardrails.py; workflow/build edits are maintainer-isolated on chore/infra branches.

modules.name: Automated Test Suites, Vectors & Synthetic Fixtures
modules.responsibility: Maintains Kotlin/Swift cross-language contract vectors, unit tests, synthetic debug loopback fixtures, and harness integration tests.
modules.regression_impact: False-positive release readiness or leakage of synthetic debug hooks into release builds.
modules.ownership_boundary: Debug hooks (src/debug/) must never leak into release APKs (verified by aapt2 in CI and release gates).

modules.name: Public Specifications, Bilingual Docs & Governance Policies
modules.responsibility: Maintains wire specification, architecture docs, installation/troubleshooting guides in EN & FA, LICENSE/NOTICE, SECURITY.md, and GitHub forms.
modules.regression_impact: Broken relative documentation anchors, overstated hardware claims, or misleading issue forms.
modules.ownership_boundary: Strictly public-safe; private operational state and research never enter public docs.
